integrity_notes: Finite-field tests corroborate but do not prove general results. Elliptic zeta recovery uses standard genus-one Frobenius theory. Absolute publication priority remains provisional.
limitations: Odd characteristic, smooth complete intersections of two quadrics, six-dimensional nonunital commutative algebras, rank-one weight-zero Rota–Baxter operators only; no full-scheme or isomorphism classification.
title: Elliptic Frobenius traces from rank-one Rota–Baxter operators on nilpotent algebras
